newsitem.title: USA: Holly seeks Nasdaq listing hearing.
newsitem.headline: Holly seeks Nasdaq listing hearing.

text.p: Holly Holdings Inc said on Thursday it filed a request for a hearing before Nasdaq's listing qualifications committee, which delays the delisting of the company until the hearing.
Holly Holdings plans to present its restructuring and diversification plans, while bringing its Country World Casino project back on track, it said.
The company's Country World Casino Inc unit was in Chapter 11, but as of March 13, the unit has repaid creditors and is in talks to arrange financing.
